title: d-3 Patti
tagline: Building a Decentralised card game that can be played by users from different chains
description: The project aims to develop a blockchain based multiplayer card game, a variant of poker popularly known as 3-patti in India, that provides a secure and trustless environment for players.Players will only need to connect using their wallet providing complete anonymity and eliminating the need of any prior registrations.
how_its_made: The game is built using smart contracts which will handle all the transactions and enforce the rules of the game such as transferring money to the pot for placing a bet. To ensure fairness, the application uses a random number generator and follows the standard rules of the game.
